Overview

Rivera is a city in RV with a population of 80,000. A border city with Brazil, known for its duty-free shopping and unique binational character. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
